I was born and raised in a small town in the Midwest. My parents were hardworking individuals who instilled in me the value of dedication and perseverance from a young age. As a child, I was always curious and eager to learn new things, which led me to excel academically throughout my school years. Despite my shy demeanor, I found joy in socializing with others and forming deep connections with those around me.

Throughout high school, I became increasingly involved in extracurricular activities, particularly in debate club and volunteer organizations. These experiences allowed me to develop critical thinking skills and hone my ability to communicate effectively with people from all walks of life. In college, I pursued a degree in psychology, driven by my fascination with human behavior and motivation. During my undergraduate studies, I had the opportunity to participate in various research projects, further fueling my passion for learning.

Upon graduation, I decided to pursue a career in counseling, hoping to help others navigate their own emotional journeys. Throughout my professional life, I have strived to maintain a strong work-life balance, recognizing the importance of self-care and personal growth. In my free time, I enjoy reading, writing, and exploring the great outdoors. Traveling has also become an essential part of my life, as it allows me to immerse myself in diverse cultures and broaden my perspective on the world.

Despite facing challenges along the way, I have remained committed to my personal and professional goals. As I continue to grow and evolve, I am grateful for the relationships and experiences that have shaped me into the person I am today. With a compassionate heart and a curious mind, I look forward to embracing whatever lies ahead.
